summary: 唐阁经典粤菜连续第十一年荣获米其林三颗星 |中国劳工布告栏 星期三，2026 年 11 月 18 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英语） 唐阁经典粤菜连续第十一年荣获米其林三颗星 香港朗廷酒店的米其林三星级粤菜餐厅唐阁继续因其注重传统的烹饪而赢得赞誉。于1988年开业，在主厨邝伟强和黄志辉的带领下，连续11年获得三星级殊荣。招牌菜，如烤酿螃蟹 在这座餐厅云集的城市
content:
唐阁经典粤菜连续第十一年荣获米其林三颗星 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 18 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
唐阁经典粤菜连续第十一年荣获米其林三星级
香港朗廷酒店的米其林三星级粤菜餐厅唐阁继续以其传统烹饪赢得赞誉。于1988年开业，在主厨邝伟强和黄志辉的带领下，连续11年获得三星级殊荣。招牌菜，如烤酿螃蟹
在这座餐厅不断寻求重塑用餐体验的城市，一些最令人难忘的餐点是那些仍然忠实于传统的餐点。在香港朗廷酒店的米其林三星级粤菜餐厅唐阁，历史悠久的食谱和细致的工艺继续优先于烹饪表演。
这家位于尖沙咀的餐厅于 1988 年开业，以经典粤式烹饪而闻名，自 2016 年以来连续 11 年获得米其林三颗星。其持久的成功源于将时令食材和对传统技术的掌握融入每道菜的核心理念。这种理念在很大程度上可以追溯到中国主厨邝伟强，他从早期就帮助建立了餐厅的烹饪特色。他的得意门生、中餐行政主厨黄志辉于 2000 年加入唐阁，在厨房里摸爬滚打，于 2018 年掌舵。
Wong 和他的团队并没有为了创新而追求创新，而是继续改进熟悉的配方，让精心挑选的原料的天然风味和质地散发出光芒。也许没有什么菜肴比餐厅的招牌烤酿蟹壳更能体现这种方法了。这道菜盛在优雅的金色蟹壳中，上面铺有一层精致的面包屑，烤得金黄酥脆。下面是丰盛的馅料，里面有嫩蟹肉、切碎的洋葱和少许奶油酱。
同样注重质地的还有红烧虾、大闸蟹籽和豆腐汤，其充满活力的橙红色表面被嫩豆腐和蛋清的丝滑混合物所取代，中间点缀着弹性的虾片。另一个亮点是用虾酱和波特酒烘烤的酿石斑鱼，它产生令人愉悦的弹性效果，同时保留了鱼的天然风味。如果想吃点清淡的小食，牛脸肉配萝卜和干枣汤提供了令人欢迎的节奏变化，配上清澈、微甜的汤汁。
芋头炒腰果、荸荠和蘑菇，怀旧之情成为焦点，这是一道经典的粤式宴会菜肴，越来越难找到如此精心制作的菜肴了。芋头被切碎并油炸，放入精致的金黄色篮子中，仍然非常酥脆。同样令人欣慰的是炒糯米，这是另一种高度依赖技术的传统美食。尽管大米具有天然的粘性，但每一粒颗粒都保持清晰，而中国腌肉的浓郁香气均匀地分布在整个大米中。
甜点延续了平衡传统与精心呈现的主题。梨形凤梨酥为餐桌增添俏皮气息，而传统芝麻卷口感清凉耐嚼，散发着浓郁的烤芝麻香味。还有带有咸味馅料的核桃糕点

T’ang Court’s timeless Cantonese cuisine earns three Michelin stars for 11th year | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
T’ang Court’s timeless Cantonese cuisine earns three Michelin stars for 11th year
T’ang Court, the three-Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant at The Langham, Hong Kong, continues to win acclaim for its tradition-focused cooking. Opened in 1988, it has held three stars for 11 consecutive years under chefs Kwong Wai-keung and Wong Chi-fai. Signature dishes like baked stuffed crab
In a city where restaurants constantly seek to reinvent the dining experience, some of the most memorable meals are those that remain faithful to tradition. At T’ang Court, the three-Michelin-starred Cantonese restaurant at The Langham, Hong Kong, time-honoured recipes and meticulous craftsmanship continue to take precedence over culinary theatrics.
Opened in 1988, the Tsim Sha Tsui institution has built its reputation on classic Cantonese cooking, earning three Michelin stars for 11 consecutive years since 2016. Its enduring success is rooted in a philosophy that places seasonal ingredients and mastery of traditional techniques at the heart of every dish. Much of that philosophy can be traced to Chinese master chef Kwong Wai-keung, who helped establish the restaurant's culinary identity from its earliest days. His protégé, executive Chinese chef Wong Chi-fai, joined T’ang Court in 2000 and worked his way through the kitchen before taking the helm in 2018.
Rather than pursuing innovation for its own sake, Wong and his team continue to refine familiar recipes, allowing the natural flavours and textures of carefully selected ingredients to shine. Perhaps no dish better captures this approach than the restaurant's signature baked stuffed crab shell. Presented in an elegant golden crab shell, the dish is topped with a delicate layer of breadcrumbs baked to a golden crisp. Beneath lies a generous filling of tender crab meat, finely chopped onions and a touch of cream sauce.
The same attention to texture carries through to the braised shrimp, hairy crab roe and bean curd soup, whose vibrant orange-red surface gives way to a silky mixture of tender tofu and egg white, punctuated by springy pieces of shrimp. Another highlight is the baked stuffed grouper with shrimp paste and port wine, which yields a pleasingly springy result with the natural flavour of the fish remaining the focus. For a lighter interlude, the beef cheek with turnip and dried dates in soup offers a welcome change of pace, served in a clear, gently sweet broth.
Nostalgia takes centre stage with the sautéed cashews, water chestnuts and mushrooms in a taro nest, a classic Cantonese banquet dish that is increasingly difficult to find executed with such care. The taro is shredded and deep-fried into a delicate, golden basket that remains remarkably crisp. Equally comforting is the wok-fried glutinous rice, another traditional favourite that relies heavily on technique. Each grain remains distinct despite the rice's naturally sticky character, while the rich aroma of Chinese preserved meats is evenly distributed throughout.
Desserts continue the theme of balancing tradition with thoughtful presentation. A pear-shaped pineapple cake brings a playful touch to the table, while traditional sesame rolls offer a cool, pleasantly chewy texture and deep roasted sesame fragrance. There are also walnut pastries with a savoury filling, alongside a smooth baked sago pudding filled with lotus seed paste. Yet perhaps the most memorable sweet is the hand-ground almond cream with egg white, wonderfully smooth and velvety, with the sweetness perfectly restrained.
While Hong Kong's fine-dining landscape continues to evolve, T’ang Court serves as a reminder that great Cantonese cooking does not always require reinvention. After nearly four decades, the restaurant remains a destination for diners who appreciate the quieter pleasures of Cantonese cuisine, where tradition is not simply remembered but continually practised and refined.

content:
意大利总领事促香港通过设计注重共性 |中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 18 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
意大利总领事促香港设计注重共性
意大利新任驻香港和澳门总领事弗朗西斯科·保罗·坎尼托表示，香港和意大利应该通过关注共同点而不是分歧来加强联系。他强调 DesignInspire 2026 上的 ABITO/HK 馆是文化交流的一个例子，并表示他希望扩大
意大利驻香港和澳门总领事弗朗西斯科·保罗·卡尼托表示，香港和意大利应该通过关注共同点而不是文化差异来建立更牢固的联系。
坎尼托于10月19日上任后表示，香港充满活力和活力的氛围让他想起了自己的根在意大利南部。 “有时我们会尝试通过更多地关注和关注差异来比较地点、地区和城市。我认为我们应该更多地关注共同点，”他说。他补充说，两地人民有着共同的进步和现代精神，以及创造将人们聚集在一起的事物的愿望。
这种做法在 ABITO/HK 中得以体现，这是一个在 DesignInspire 2026 上首次在香港亮相的特别展馆。该展馆由意大利外交与国际合作部制作和推广，与米兰国际家具展以及意大利驻香港和澳门总领事馆合作，并由设计工作室 Palomba Serafini Associati 策划。展馆将来自意大利和香港的标志性家具和设计作品并置，采用基于时间线的叙事方式来追踪两地生活方式、居住空间和审美价值的演变。
坎尼托强​​调，展馆并非一次性合作，而是香港与意大利之间长期交流的一部分。他举例说，香港参加了2025年威尼斯建筑双年展，其中一幅以香港竹脚手架技术为主题的装置作品，向意大利观众展示了当地的建筑实践。他还提到了由意大利建筑师设计的香港岛建筑，称它们将意大利元素与独特的香港风格结合在一起。
坎尼托表示，文化交流应该包括从积极的意义上拥抱他所说的“污染”，不同的文化应该走到一起，而不是保持分离。他表示，设计是意大利文化外交的支柱之一，有助于在国际上推广该国，同时连接不同的文化和经验。
坎尼托希望扩大与这座城市的合作范围，超越时尚、食品、葡萄酒和文化等传统领域，并将金融、航运和基础设施视为有潜力建立更密切联系的领域。他表示，尽管他的前任做出了努力，但加强两地关系仍有很多工作要做，他满怀热情来到这里，相信可以取得更多成果。
Cannito表示，在设计领域，可以采取更多措施将意大利设计带入香港更广阔的市场，包括引入更多新兴意大利品牌和较小的品牌。领事馆计划全年更频繁地组织小型活动，以保持参与度并继续就意大利和香港设计进行对话。

Italian Consul General urges Hong Kong to focus on commonalities through design | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Italian Consul General urges Hong Kong to focus on commonalities through design
Italy's new Consul General to Hong Kong and Macao, Francesco Paolo Cannito, says Hong Kong and Italy should strengthen ties by focusing on commonalities rather than differences. He highlights the ABITO/HK pavilion at DesignInspire 2026 as an example of cultural exchange and says he hopes to broaden
Hong Kong and Italy should build stronger ties by focusing on what they have in common rather than their cultural differences, Italy's Consul General to Hong Kong and Macao Francesco Paolo Cannito has said.
Having taken up his post on 19 October, Cannito said Hong Kong's vibrant and energetic atmosphere had reminded him of his roots in southern Italy. 'Sometimes we try to compare places and territories and cities by looking and focusing more on the differences. I think we should focus more on commonalities,' he said. He added that people in both places shared a spirit of progress and modernity, as well as a desire to create things that bring people together.
This approach is reflected in ABITO/HK, a special pavilion making its Hong Kong debut at DesignInspire 2026. Produced and promoted by Italy's Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, the pavilion is presented in collaboration with Salone del Mobile.Milano and the Consulate General of Italy in Hong Kong and Macao, and curated by design studio Palomba Serafini Associati. Juxtaposing iconic furniture and design pieces from Italy and Hong Kong, the pavilion uses a timeline-based narrative to trace the evolution of lifestyles, living spaces and aesthetic values in both places.
Cannito stressed that the pavilion was not a one-off collaboration but part of a longstanding exchange between Hong Kong and Italy. He cited Hong Kong's participation in the 2025 Venice Architecture Biennale, where an installation drawing on the city's bamboo scaffolding techniques showcased the local construction practice to Italian audiences. He also pointed to buildings on Hong Kong Island designed by Italian architects, saying they combined elements reminiscent of Italy with a distinctly Hong Kong touch.
Cannito said cultural exchange should involve embracing what he described as 'contamination' in a positive sense, with different cultures coming together rather than remaining separate. He said design was one of the pillars of Italy's cultural diplomacy, helping promote the country internationally while connecting different cultures and experiences.
Cannito hopes to broaden cooperation with the city beyond traditional areas such as fashion, food, wine and culture, identifying finance, shipping and infrastructure as sectors with potential for closer ties. He said there was still much work to be done to strengthen relations between the two places, despite the efforts of his predecessor, and that he had arrived with enthusiasm and believed more could be achieved.
In the design sector, Cannito said there was more that could be done to bring Italian design to a wider market in Hong Kong, including introducing more emerging Italian brands and smaller labels. The consulate plans to organise smaller events more frequently throughout the year to maintain engagement and keep conversations about Italian and Hong Kong design going.

content:
香港管弦乐团在新音乐总监的带领下上演罕见的马勒第八交响曲中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 18 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
香港管弦乐团在新音乐总监的带领下上演罕见的马勒第八交响曲
近600名音乐家和歌手在香港演出了马勒《第八交响曲》，标志着塔尔莫·佩尔托科斯基的任期开始，也标志着乐团完成了所有马勒交响曲。音乐会获得全场起立鼓掌。
近600名乐手及歌手齐聚一堂，为香港管弦乐团首演马勒第八交响曲。这场音乐会标志着塔尔莫·佩尔托科斯基音乐总监任期的雄心勃勃的开始，并完成了乐团演奏马勒所有交响曲的旅程。
作品的选择反映了26岁的芬恩对乐团和香港在国际舞台上的地位的雄心。正如他所说，《千人交响曲》应该“留到最特殊、最罕见的场合”。对于文化中心音乐厅的许多人来说，这将是他们第一次有机会现场听到它。
扩大后的乐团还包括六个合唱团：香港管弦合唱团、伦敦管弦乐团合唱团、学习合唱团、香港儿童合唱团，以及圣保罗男女中学和英华书院的合唱团。八位独唱演员分别是女高音杰奎琳·瓦格纳、陈·雷斯、香港本土歌手邝路易丝、女低音卡特里奥娜·莫里森和萨莎·库克、男高音托马斯·卡塔贾拉、男中音林纳德斯·坎达林塞夫斯和男低音沉阳。
甚至在第一个和弦之前，表演者的数量就清楚地表明这是一项艰巨的任务。佩尔托科斯基面临的挑战是赋予这种音阶的表演统一性和方向性。据报道，从维尼（Veni，造物主精神）的开场风琴和弦来看，答案是肯定的。
马勒将这部作品分为两个看似截然不同的部分。第一个是中世纪赞美诗《Veni, Creator Spiritus》的热烈背景。更长的第二部分设定了歌德《浮士德》的最后一幕，从寂静、荒凉的风景走向救赎。连接这两个世界是任何指挥家面临的核心挑战。佩尔托科斯基称这首乐谱是“宇宙的、普遍的、天堂般的、团结的”。
当神秘合唱团进入最后的铜管乐和管风琴演奏时，观众起立鼓掌，佩尔托科斯基五次谢幕。对于首次演奏该作品的管弦乐队来说，庆祝活动确实是理所应当的。
乐团现在转向欧洲八个城市的巡演，将于 11 月 23 日在巴塞罗那开幕。巡演包括在柏林爱乐乐团、汉堡易北爱乐音乐厅和维也纳音乐厅进行首演。西九龙文化区主席陈智思表示，这是国际观众热切期待的任期的大胆开始，它展示了香港最好的一面。

Hong Kong Philharmonic stages rare Mahler Eighth under new music director | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong Philharmonic stages rare Mahler Eighth under new music director
Nearly 600 musicians and singers performed Mahler’s Eighth Symphony in Hong Kong, marking the start of Tarmo Peltokoski’s tenure and the orchestra’s completion of all Mahler symphonies. The concert received a standing ovation.
Nearly 600 musicians and singers came together for the Hong Kong Philharmonic’s first performance of Mahler’s Eighth Symphony. The concert marked an ambitious opening to Tarmo Peltokoski’s tenure as music director and completed the orchestra’s journey through all of Mahler’s symphonies.
The choice of work reflected the 26-year-old Finn’s ambitions for both the orchestra and Hong Kong’s place on the international stage. As he put it, the “Symphony of a Thousand” should be “saved for the most special, rare occasions.” For many in the Cultural Centre Concert Hall, this would have been their first chance to hear it live.
The expanded orchestra was joined by six choirs: the Hong Kong Philharmonic Chorus, the London Philharmonic Choir, the Learners Chorus, the Hong Kong Children’s Choir, and choirs from St Paul’s Co-educational College and Ying Wa College. The eight soloists were sopranos Jacquelyn Wagner, Chen Reiss, and Hong Kong’s own Louise Kwong, altos Catriona Morison and Sasha Cooke, tenor Tuomas Katajala, baritone Rinalds Kandalincevs, and bass Shenyang.
Even before the first chord, the sheer number of performers made it clear this was a colossal undertaking. Peltokoski’s challenge was to give the performance of this scale unity and direction. From the opening organ chord of Veni, Creator Spiritus, the answer was an emphatic yes, according to the report.
Mahler wrote the work in two parts that seem worlds apart. The first is a blazing setting of the medieval hymn Veni, Creator Spiritus. The much longer second part sets the final scene of Goethe’s Faust, moving from a hushed, desolate landscape toward redemption. Connecting those two worlds is a central challenge for any conductor. Peltokoski calls the score “cosmic, universal, heavenly, uniting.”
As the Chorus Mysticus rose into the final blaze of brass and organ, the audience rose for a standing ovation, and Peltokoski returned for five curtain calls. For an orchestra playing the work for the first time, the celebration was truly justified.
The orchestra now turns to an eight-city European tour, opening in Barcelona on November 23. The tour includes debuts at the Berliner Philharmonie, Hamburg’s Elbphilharmonie, and Vienna’s Konzerthaus. It was a bold start to a tenure that international audiences are eagerly awaiting, and it showcases the very best of Hong Kong, according to Bernard Charnwut Chan, chairman of the West Kowloon Cultural District.

冲浪者之眼：香港眼科医生解释翼状胬肉的风险和治疗方法中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 18 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
冲浪者之眼：香港眼科医生解释翼状胬肉的风险和治疗方法
Prudence Chow 医生介绍了翼状胬肉（一种与紫外线照射有关的良性眼睛生长物）、其症状以及何时需要手术。她建议佩戴 UV400 太阳镜和帽子进行预防，并敦促及时进行医疗评估以发现异常生长或视力变化。
一位香港眼科医生解释了翼状胬肉的成因、症状和治疗方法，翼状胬肉是一种眼睛上的良性生长物，俗称“冲浪者眼”。眼科专家 Prudence Chow Po-chee 医生在《The Standard》上撰文称，这种情况是结膜（覆盖在眼白上的薄膜）缓慢生长的纤维血管生长。
翼状胬肉通常始于鼻侧，靠近鼻子，并可能延伸到透明角膜。这种病症因它的翅膀状形状而得名。早期翼状胬肉可能不会引起任何症状，但发炎时会导致发红、刺激和异物感。随着它的生长，它可能会引起散光或覆盖部分角膜或视轴，导致视力模糊。
周医生表示，确切原因尚不清楚，但翼状胬肉与长期暴露于紫外线、风和灰尘有关。老年人、男性以及长时间在户外工作或运动的人的风险更高。小的、无症状的翼状胬肉通常不需要治疗。人工泪液可以缓解砂砾或刺激，如果生长发炎，可以开短期类固醇滴眼液。
如果翼状胬肉导致严重散光、侵犯瞳孔或影响视力、反复发炎、导致持续不适或生长迅速，则可以考虑手术切除翼状胬肉。由于可能会复发，眼科医生经常用患者自己的结膜组织覆盖切除部位，并可能使用抗代谢药物来减少再生的机会。
为了预防，周一岳建议长时间在户外活动的人士戴上宽边帽子和太阳镜，以提供可靠的紫外线防护。她推荐标有 UV400 或 100% 紫外线防护的镜片，可阻挡 UVA 和 UVB 射线，并指出仅深色镜片并不能保证防护。虽然翼状胬肉是良性的，但眼睛上的异常生长有时可能类似于更严重的疾病，包括眼表面鳞状瘤或其他癌前病变。任何发现新的或增大的生长、持续发红、不适或视力模糊的人都应立即寻求眼科医生的评估。

Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Surfer’s eye: Hong Kong ophthalmologist explains pterygium risks and treatments
Dr Prudence Chow describes pterygium, a benign eye growth linked to UV exposure, its symptoms, and when surgery is needed. She advises wearing UV400 sunglasses and hats for prevention, and urges prompt medical assessment for unusual growths or vision changes.
A Hong Kong ophthalmologist has explained the causes, symptoms and treatments of pterygium, a benign growth on the eye commonly known as “surfer’s eye”. Writing in The Standard, Dr Prudence Chow Po-chee, a specialist in ophthalmology, said the condition is a slow-growing fibrovascular growth of the conjunctiva – the thin membrane covering the white of the eye.
Pterygium usually begins on the nasal side, near the nose, and may extend onto the clear cornea. Its wing-like shape gives the condition its name. Early pterygium may cause no symptoms, but when inflamed it can lead to redness, irritation and a foreign body sensation. As it grows, it may induce astigmatism or cover part of the cornea or visual axis, resulting in blurred vision.
According to Dr Chow, the exact cause is unclear, but pterygium is associated with chronic exposure to ultraviolet (UV) light, wind and dust. Risk is higher in older people, men, and those who spend substantial time outdoors for work or sport. Small, symptom-free pterygia usually do not require treatment. Artificial tears can relieve grittiness or irritation, while short-term steroid eye drops may be prescribed if the growth becomes inflamed.
Surgery to excise the pterygium may be considered if it causes significant astigmatism, encroaches on the pupil or affects vision, repeatedly becomes inflamed, causes persistent discomfort, or grows rapidly. Because recurrence is possible, ophthalmologists often cover the excision site with the patient’s own conjunctival tissue and may use anti-metabolite medication to reduce the chance of regrowth.
For prevention, Dr Chow advised people who spend long periods outdoors to wear a wide-brimmed hat and sunglasses that provide reliable UV protection. She recommended lenses labelled UV400 or 100 per cent UV protection, which block UVA and UVB rays, noting that dark lenses alone do not guarantee protection. Although pterygium is benign, unusual growths on the eye can occasionally resemble more serious conditions, including ocular surface squamous neoplasia or other pre-cancerous conditions. Anyone who notices a new or enlarging growth, persistent redness, discomfort, or blurred vision should seek prompt assessment by an ophthalmologist.

17 岁男孩在香港公园与 15 岁女孩发生不雅行为中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 18 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
17岁男孩因在香港公园与15岁女孩发生不雅行为而被拘留
一名 17 岁男孩因涉嫌对一名 16 岁以下儿童做出不雅行为而被捕，因为 Threads 上的视频显示一对情侣在海心公园玩耍。该事件发生在五月份，并被秘密拍摄。警方和教育局正在跟进。
2026 年 11 月 18 日 02:52 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 18 日 04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
周二，一名 17 岁男孩因涉嫌对 16 岁以下儿童做出不雅行为而被捕，此前 Threads 上流传的视频显示一对年轻夫妇在土瓜湾海心公园拥抱并明显进行不雅行为，其中一人穿着校服。
九龙城警区罪案支援人员深入调查后拘捕该名男童。他正在被拘留。消息人士称，这名男孩与一名15岁女孩已经交往两年，事件发生在今年5月，并被秘密拍摄。该片段近日被发布到网上，并以歌曲《听海浪》为背景音乐，引发网上讨论。原始视频已被删除，但副本继续在线程上传播。
网友们谴责该视频可能涉及儿童色情内容，并呼吁人们不要转发该视频，以免对涉案人员造成进一步伤害。周二晚上8点左右，一些人回到展馆表演这首歌，吸引了一群年轻人，他们在大约一个小时后散去。
教育局表示极为关注，已联络学校，了解学校正在认真跟进，并将为有需要的学生提供辅导和支持。警方也在跟进。
该局提醒学校加强学生正确价值观和行为的培养，并表示将继续提供支持。声明表示，在2026年4月发布的价值观教育课程框架中，性教育仍然是重点，涵盖个人、家庭、社会和社会各个方面，并将继续更新课程指南、提供教师培训和开发资源，以帮助学生了解性教育、提高自我保护意识和发展批判性思维。

Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Boy, 17, held over indecent act with girl, 15, in Hong Kong park
A 17-year-old boy was arrested on suspicion of committing an indecent act with a child under 16 after videos on Threads showed a couple at Hoi Sham Park. The incident occurred in May and was secretly filmed. Police and the Education Bureau are following up.
18 Nov 2026 at 02:52 HKT · updated 18 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
A 17-year-old boy was arrested on Tuesday on suspicion of committing an indecent act with a child under 16, after videos circulated on Threads showing a young couple embracing and apparently engaging in indecent behaviour at Hoi Sham Park in To Kwa Wan, with one person in school uniform.
Kowloon City police district crime support officers arrested the boy after an in-depth investigation. He is being detained. Sources said the boy and a 15-year-old girl have been dating for two years and the incident occurred in May this year and was secretly filmed. The footage was recently posted online with the song "Listening to the Waves" as background music, sparking online discussion. The original video has been deleted, but copies continue to circulate on Threads.
Netizens condemned the footage as potentially involving child pornography and urged people not to share it to avoid further harm to those involved. Around 8pm on Tuesday, some people returned to the pavilion to perform the song, drawing a crowd of young people who dispersed after about an hour.
The Education Bureau said it is extremely concerned, has contacted the school and understands it is following up seriously and will provide counselling and support to students in need. Police are also following up.
The bureau reminded schools to strengthen students' correct values and behaviour and said it will continue to provide support. It said sex education remains a key focus under the Values Education Curriculum Framework published in April 2026, covering personal, family, social and societal aspects, and that it will continue to update curriculum guidelines, provide teacher training and develop resources to help students understand sex education, raise self-protection awareness and develop critical thinking.

黄埔商场将于2027年开设香港最大的匹克球馆
黄埔商场宣布建设占地 100,000 平方英尺的体育中心，设有香港最大的双高匹克球馆、HYROX 区、游泳池和酒吧。 2027 年 4 月开业。GO24 Fitness 和香港匹克球联赛与 ONYX 合作，旨在增加客流量和消费。
根据 2026 年 11 月 18 日发布的一份声明，黄埔军校宣布与 The Foundry Athletics ONYX x HKPL 建立战略合作伙伴关系，在商场打造一个超过 100,000 平方英尺的旗舰综合体育和社交空间。
新租户将设有 HYROX 训练区、健康管理和康复区，以及号称香港最大的符合国际比赛标准的双层泡菜球馆。它还包括室外网球场、室内匹克球场、室内温水游泳池、高尔夫模拟器、运动主题酒吧、特色咖啡厅、商务休息室和儿童游乐区。健身区24小时开放。
该项目是高端健身品牌 ONYX by GO24 Fitness 与香港匹克球联盟 (HKPL) 之间的合作，后者是亚洲最大且发展最快的匹克球社区之一。
和记地产集团市场营销助理总监邱伟强表示，随着 Anytime Fitness、The Foundry Athletics ONYX x HKPL 以及 Sports Pro 游泳训练中心开业，商场正在加强其体育和休闲服务，这将吸引来自香港和大湾区的体育爱好者，并增加人流量和消费。
Yau表示，新设施将于2027年4月在美食广场开业，随着本周开始的新租户和一系列圣诞促销活动，客流量和营业额预计将同比增长30%以上。
黄埔表示，今年已引入30个新租户，瞄准年轻顾客，包括Torikizoku、Fish in Rice、Chung So Dessert和数个体育中心。 TIDES 中型现场表演场地于一年前开业，已举办了 100 多场活动，并帮助推动了客流量和餐饮消费。

The Whampoa mall to open Hong Kong's largest pickleball arena in 2027 | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
The Whampoa mall to open Hong Kong's largest pickleball arena in 2027
The Whampoa mall announces a 100,000 sq ft sports hub with Hong Kong's largest double-height pickleball arena, HYROX zone, pool and bar. Opening April 2027. Partnership with ONYX by GO24 Fitness and HK Pickleball League aims to boost footfall and spending.
The Whampoa has announced a strategic partnership with The Foundry Athletics ONYX x HKPL to create a flagship integrated sports and social space of more than 100,000 square feet at the mall, according to a statement published on 18 November 2026.
The new tenant will feature a HYROX training zone, a health management and recovery area, and what is billed as Hong Kong's largest double-height pickleball arena meeting international competition standards. It will also include an outdoor tennis court, indoor pickleball courts, a heated indoor pool, golf simulators, a sports-themed bar, a specialty coffee shop, a business lounge and a children's play area. The fitness zone will operate 24 hours.
The project is a collaboration between high-end fitness brand ONYX by GO24 Fitness and the Hong Kong Pickleball League (HKPL), one of Asia's largest and fastest-growing pickleball communities.
Nicol Yau, Assistant Director of Marketing at Hutchison Property Group, said the mall is strengthening its sports and leisure offering after the openings of Anytime Fitness, The Foundry Athletics ONYX x HKPL and Sports Pro swimming training centre, which should draw sports enthusiasts from across Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area and boost footfall and spending.
Yau said the new facility will open at the food court in April 2027 and that with new tenants and a series of Christmas promotions starting this week, footfall and turnover are expected to rise more than 30 per cent year on year.
The Whampoa said it has brought in 30 new tenants this year targeting younger customers, including Torikizoku, Fish in Rice, Chung So Dessert and several sports centres. The TIDES mid-sized live performance venue, which opened a year ago, has hosted more than 100 events and helped drive footfall and dining spending.

中加关税豁免延长两年，加拿大扩大钢铝减免|中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 18 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
中加关税豁免延长两年 加拿大扩大钢铝减免
中国和加拿大同意将初步联合安排下的关税豁免期限延长两年，加拿大进一步扩大对中国钢铁和铝产品的豁免范围。中方将调整对加拿大部分农产品和水产品的反歧视措施。乙
2026 年 11 月 18 日，香港时间 01:12 · 更新于 11 月 18 日，04:24 · 阅读时间 2 分钟
11月17日，习近平主席与加拿大总理卡尼会晤后，中国和加拿大同意将初步联合安排下的关税豁免措施延长两年。习近平对双边关系提出了多项建议，包括增进政治互信、管控和化解分歧、加强协调、维护多边主义和世界贸易组织体系。
中国商务部新闻发言人表示，在两国领导人重要共识指引下，双方在相互尊重、合作基础上进行了多轮经贸磋商。由此达成了一项补充性联合安排，将豁免措施延长两年。加方将进一步扩大对华钢铁、铝产品的豁免范围，中方将根据中国法律法规调整对加部分农产品和水产品的反歧视措施。
双方还就电子商务合作、中资银行在加设立分行、改善营商环境等达成积极共识。发言人表示，这些安排有望深化经贸合作，给两国人民带来更大福祉。
双方将尽快加快国内程序落实成果，并继续探讨深化经贸关系的进一步安排。双方还将利用双边经贸联委会机制扩大合作、解决问题、管控分歧，推动中加经贸关系健康稳定可持续发展。

China and Canada extend tariff exemptions for two years, Canada to expand steel and aluminium relief | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
China and Canada extend tariff exemptions for two years, Canada to expand steel and aluminium relief
China and Canada have agreed to extend tariff exemptions under their preliminary joint arrangement for two years, with Canada further expanding exemptions for Chinese steel and aluminium products. China will adjust counter-discriminatory measures on some Canadian agricultural and aquatic products. B
18 Nov 2026 at 01:12 HKT · updated 18 Nov, 04:24 · 2 min read
China and Canada have agreed to extend tariff exemption measures under their preliminary joint arrangement for two years, following a meeting between President Xi Jinping and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on 17 November. Xi offered several proposals for bilateral ties, including enhancing political trust, managing and resolving differences, and strengthening coordination to uphold multilateralism and the World Trade Organisation system.
According to a spokesperson for China's Ministry of Commerce, guided by the important consensus of the two leaders, both sides conducted multiple rounds of economic and trade consultations based on mutual respect and cooperation. These resulted in a supplementary joint arrangement that extends the exemption measures for two years. Canada will further expand the scope of exemptions for Chinese steel and aluminium products, while China will adjust its counter-discriminatory measures on some Canadian agricultural and aquatic products in accordance with Chinese laws and regulations.
The two sides also reached positive consensus on e-commerce cooperation, the establishment of branches by Chinese banks in Canada, and improving the business environment. The spokesperson said these arrangements are expected to deepen economic and trade cooperation and bring greater benefits to the people of both countries.
The spokesperson added that both sides will accelerate domestic procedures to implement the outcomes as soon as possible, and will continue to explore further arrangements to deepen economic and trade ties. They will also make use of the bilateral economic and trade joint committee mechanism to expand cooperation, resolve issues, and manage differences, with the aim of promoting a healthy, stable and sustainable development of China-Canada economic and trade relations.

content:
屈臣氏称第三方供应商违规事件并未影响香港业务中国劳工公告栏
星期三, 18 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港和中国劳工新闻（英文）
屈臣氏表示第三方供应商违规事件并未影响香港业务
屈臣氏集团表示，涉及部分欧洲网站搜索功能的第三方供应商的网络安全事件并未影响其香港或亚洲业务，也没有涉及客户数据泄露。该组织尚未通知隐私专员。
屈臣氏集团表示，它已获悉涉及一家第三方供应商的网络安全事件，该供应商为其多家欧洲企业的网站提供搜索功能。该组织强调，供应商从未被授权从其任何业务中获取客户数据，并且该事件不涉及任何个人数据泄露。
屈臣氏集团发言人在回应询问的声明中表示，该事件不涉及其香港或亚洲业务，也没有泄露任何个人数据。因此，该组织表示没有向个人资料私隐专员办公室报告此事。
香港网络安全事件应变中心表示，香港近期发生多起网络安全事件，影响多个组织和系统。它补充说，现阶段没有信息表明这些事件是由同一类型的攻击引起的。该中心提醒企业和组织，网络防御不应超出阻止攻击者的范围，而应注重数据管理，这样即使个人账户或系统遭到入侵，大量敏感数据也不会同时暴露。
香港资讯科技商会名誉会长方宝侨建议企业检讨授予第三方供应商的访问权限，确保供应商只能访问其工作所需的数据，并加强对相关系统的加密和监控。

Watsons says third-party supplier breach did not affect Hong Kong operations | China Labour Bulletin Board
Wednesday, 18 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Watsons says third-party supplier breach did not affect Hong Kong operations
Watsons Group says a cybersecurity incident involving a third-party supplier for search functions on some European websites did not affect its Hong Kong or Asian operations and involved no customer data leakage. The group has not notified the privacy commissioner.
Watsons Group has said it is aware of a cybersecurity incident involving a third-party supplier that provided search functions for websites of several of its European businesses. The group stressed that the supplier was never authorised to access customer data from any of its operations and that the incident did not involve any leakage of personal data.
In a statement responding to inquiries, a Watsons Group spokesperson said the incident did not involve its Hong Kong or Asian businesses and that no personal data had been leaked. As a result, the group said it did not report the matter to the Office of the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data.
The Hong Kong Cybersecurity Incident Response Centre said the city has recently seen a number of cybersecurity incidents affecting various organisations and systems. It added that, at this stage, there was no information suggesting the incidents were caused by the same type of attack. The centre reminded enterprises and organisations that network defence should go beyond blocking attackers and focus on data management, so that even if individual accounts or systems are compromised, large amounts of sensitive data are not exposed at the same time.
Fong Po-kiu, honorary president of the Hong Kong Information Technology Chamber of Commerce, advised companies to review the access rights granted to third-party suppliers, ensuring that suppliers can only access data necessary for their work, and to strengthen encryption and monitoring of related systems.

【大紀元2026年11月18日訊】「香港反送中紀念館」（Free Hong Kong Museum）近日落戶洛杉磯縣。上週六（11月14日），民運、人權團體及關注香港民主的人士聚集在蒙特利公園市，共同為新館揭幕。
2026年11月14日，中國民主黨創黨元老朱虞夫（左一）、「中國民主黨全國聯合總部」 執委會主席郭嵐（左二）、「中國民主黨全國聯合總部」主席鄭存柱（右三）、港人David（右二）、「香港反送中紀念館」副館長劉廣賢（右一）等共同為紀念館剪綵。（主辦方提供）
蒙市為華人聚居區，素有美國「第一個郊區唐人街」之稱，上世紀曾吸引大批廣東及香港僑民定居。紀念館位於南嘉菲爾德大道300號111室。
與會者指出，2019年的反送中運動是香港人捍衛自由、民主與法治的重要篇章，也是全球華人反抗專制、追求自由的象徵。在美西設立常設紀念館，旨在永久保存這段歷史，銘記港人為自由所付出的犧牲，並向國際社會揭示中共背棄「一國兩制」承諾、侵害人權的事實，讓記憶不被抹去、精神得以傳承。
紀念館的揭幕，正值香港局勢再受關注之時。11月5日，香港高等法院以「串謀勾結外國勢力危害國家安全」罪，重判民主運動代表黃之鋒監禁10年。判決隨即受到歐美多國外交部聯合譴責，他們要求港共政府停止利用《國安法》的不公正檢控。國際特赦組織亦警告，勿將「刑事化和平倡議」常態化。
館長鄭存柱博士表示，自由非特權者所賦予，民主需透過努力奮鬥才能擁有。「香港人的抗爭給所有華人示範：若不抗爭，強權隨時可剝奪民主自由。」他強調，紀念館要提醒世人勿忘港人的付出，讓「光復香港、時代革命」的精神在全球華人社區持續燃燒。
副館長劉廣賢指出，紀念館為銘記歷史、傳承自由精神提供平台，將讓更多人瞭解反送中運動，並更深刻地認識法治、言論自由與司法獨立的珍貴。
現場同步舉行「聲援黃之鋒」活動，回顧其自少年投入社會運動、身陷囹圄仍堅守信念的歷程。主辦方表示，中共及港府企圖以長期監禁製造寒蟬效應、抹去抗爭記憶，海外紀念館的成立正是對此最有力的回擊。
設計師梁淨淨曾在香港生活十年，親眼見證香港從自由走向失去自由的過程。她在2019年反送中期間在港，看見從老人到學生、孩子都走上街頭，爭取的只是當年承諾的「一國兩制」。
梁淨淨感嘆太多人因此被捕、入獄、流亡，對黃之鋒再遭重判深感不公，盼更多人為其發聲。她參與建館，就是希望人們記住歷史與付出代價的人：「只要不遺忘、不放棄，香港仍有希望。」
義工馮仍表示，紀念館能保存港人自由抗爭的記憶，讓更多人了解香港過去與未來，共同聲援人權、民主與自由；陸乾坤在對港人欽佩之餘，亦期望透過紀念館讓精神火炬持續傳遞。
2026年11月14日，民運界、人權團體及關注香港民主自由的人士為「香港反送中紀念館」舉辦了揭幕儀式。圖為紀念館建館義工合照。（主辦方提供）
最後，與會者向國際社會呼籲，敦促各國持續關注香港政治犯處境，採取實際行動施壓，要求立即無條件釋放黃之鋒及所有因政治信念被囚的良心犯。◇

马来西亚-台湾：安瓦尔的中国路线引发了静悄悄的投资冻结
近年来，台湾科技公司日月光已将其业务扩展到马来西亚，这是众多在东南亚国家开展业务的台湾公司之一（在新窗口中打开）。这就是马来西亚，其总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣（Anwar Ibrahim）八月份告诉半岛电视台，他将台湾视为“中国的一部分”。
11月10日，台湾外交部发言人萧光伟证实，台北已暂停与马来西亚的投资谈判，以维护“国家主权、经济安全和台湾投资者的权利”。两天后，安瓦尔告诉议会（在新窗口中打开）原定于 10 月份举行的双边经济合作委员会会议已被推迟，布城已联系恢复会议。
早在八月份，在安瓦尔发表初步评论后，我在《翻译》（在新窗口中打开）中指出，东南亚各国政府将其关于台湾的声明视为随口而出的言论，而北京则将其归档在累积记录中。台湾和马来西亚之间的僵局表明北京不再是唯一记分的一方。它还测试了这篇文章中更狭隘的判断：出于成本和关税原因在马来西亚存在的台湾投资者不会被电视采访所感动。
台北的此举遵循了 2025 年 9 月设定的模式，当时台湾经济部因台湾办事处降级而宣布对运往南非的 47 种芯片相关产品实施出口管制，并在两天后比勒陀利亚同意会谈后暂停了该计划（在新窗口中打开）。今年三月，在首尔将台湾列为“中国（台湾）”的争议中，台北在居留卡上重新标记了韩国国民。它威胁要采取第二步措施，并一度搁置（在新窗口中打开）首尔采取行动修复其电子到达系统，并保留了第一步（在新窗口中打开）。
每项措施都有分级，并留有解决的空间。马来西亚的也是以同样的方式建造的，而且更安静。该决定从 10 月份开始，直到 11 月 9 日《日经亚洲》（在新窗口中打开）报道时才浮出水面。台北没有设定最后期限，表示仍在与吉隆坡谈判，并希望马来西亚能够认识到（在新窗口中打开）双方之间密切的投资关系和长期的信任。它似乎想要的是针对台北本身做出的姿态。
台湾在马来西亚的分量就是其企业的分量。
安瓦尔在议会的回答仅提出恢复谈判，除此之外没有其他任何内容。他说，马来西亚在一个中国问题上“不能妥协”。他否认支持攻击台湾并重申

Malaysia-Taiwan: Anwar’s China line triggers a quiet investment freeze
Taiwanese technology company Advanced Semiconductor Engineering has extended its operations to Malaysia in recent years, one of a number (Opens in new window) of Taiwanese firms setting up a presence in the Southeast Asian nation. This is the same Malaysia whose Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim told Al Jazeera in August that he saw Taiwan “as part of China, period”.
On 10 November, Taiwan’s foreign ministry spokesman Hsiao Kuang-wei confirmed (Opens in new window) that Taipei had paused investment talks with Malaysia to safeguard “national sovereignty, economic security and the rights of Taiwanese investors”. Two days later Anwar told parliament t (Opens in new window)hat a meeting of the bilateral Economic Cooperation Committee, due in October, had been postponed, and that Putrajaya had reached out to resume it.
Back in August, after Anwar’s initial comments, I argued in (Opens in new window)The Interpreter (Opens in new window) that Southeast Asian governments treat their statements on Taiwan as passing remarks, while Beijing files them in a cumulative record. The freeze between Taiwan and Malaysia shows that Beijing is no longer the only one keeping score. It also tests a narrower judgement in that piece: that Taiwanese investors, present in Malaysia for cost and tariff reasons, would not be moved by a television interview.
Taipei’s move follows a pattern set in September 2025, when its economics ministry announced export controls on 47 chip-related products bound for South Africa, over the downgrading of Taiwan’s office, and suspended the plan two days later (Opens in new window)when Pretoria agreed to talk. In March Taipei relabelled South Korean nationals on residence cards in a dispute over Seoul listing Taiwan as “China (Taiwan)”. It threatened a second step, shelved it once (Opens in new window) Seoul moved to fix its e-arrival system, and kept the first (Opens in new window).
Each measure was graduated and left room for a settlement. The Malaysian one is built the same way, and more quietly. The decision dated from October and surfaced only when Nikkei Asia (Opens in new window) reported it on 9 November. Taipei set no deadline, says it is still talking to Kuala Lumpur, and hopes Malaysia will recognise (Opens in new window)the close investment ties and long-standing trust between them. What it appears to want is a gesture addressed to Taipei itself.
Taiwan’s weight in Malaysia is the weight of its firms.
Anwar’s answer in parliament offered the resumption of talks and little else. Malaysia, he said (Opens in new window), “cannot compromise” on One China. He denied having endorsed an attack on Taiwan and repeated his preference for a peaceful resolution, while describing any Chinese decision to use force as a domestic matter in which Malaysia would not interfere. His government separates diplomatic recognition from economic engagement. Taipei’s freeze refuses that separation: it makes the economic channel conditional on the political language.
Whether Taipei returns to the table without a gesture will show how far its leverage reaches. So far the cost to Malaysia has been small, to judge by the figures Anwar gave parliament: bilateral trade of RM254.21 billion in the first nine months of the year, with exports to Taiwan up 88%, and no sign, he said, of investors withdrawing.
The sharper cost is domestic: opposition leader Hamzah Zainudin (Opens in new window) asked why the prime minister had to “rock the boat”, and urged caution with the country’s fourth-largest trading partner.
ASE manufacturing facility, provider of semiconductor manufacturing services in electronics, Penang, Malaysia (Universal Images Group via Getty Images)
The limits of Taipei’s gesture lie in the structure of the relationship. Taiwan’s weight in Malaysia is the weight of its firms, and those firms run production networks through Penang: according to the state’s assembly speaker (Opens in new window), many Taiwan-made wafers go there for packaging and testing before export to the United States. A government whose main asset abroad is its companies’ capital cannot squeeze the host economy without squeezing them first. Taipei has met this limit before: after the South African controls, Bloomberg reported (Opens in new window)second thoughts among officials, possibly over the impact on firms such as TSMC.
The August judgement on investors holds for existing plants and was too sanguine about new ones. Lin Kai-min (Opens in new window) of the Taiwan Chamber of Commerce in Malaysia says current operations have barely been affected, but investors are warier of new commitments, and firms with American and European customers may rethink where they place future or sensitive capacity. That warning locates the pressure in the requirements of buyers in the United States and Europe, who sit above both Taipei and Kuala Lumpur in the chain and answer to neither.
ASEAN leaders are meeting in Manila this week, and APEC leaders gather in Shenzhen on 18 and 19 November, where Taipei has already received an emailed invitation rather (Opens in new window) than the customary envoy. ASEAN still has no common line on Taiwan and no shared record of what each member has conceded, so each government will weigh Beijing’s ledger and Taipei’s on its own. The April 2025 joint statement with China committed Malaysia on Taiwan with no mention of peaceful means. Whatever Kuala Lumpur signs with Beijing around the Shenzhen summit will show whether the peaceful resolution Anwar invoked in parliament reaches the written text. Taipei, with no date set for the committee, will be reading it as well.
Aniello Iannone is a Lecturer in International Relations and International Political Economy at President University, Indonesia, where he also serves as Secretary General of the ASEAN Studies Centre.

中联部副部长马辉表示，大国能否保持战略稳定，对世界和平与发展具有重要意义
莫斯科，11 月 18 日。/塔斯社/。中共中央对外联络部副部长马辉对塔斯社表示，俄中美峰会对全世界来说都是一件重大事件，因为这三个国家可以发挥关键作用。
他说：“这件事的发生本身就是一件重大事件。大国、大国必须对和平承担特殊责任。我们必须在世界事务中发挥关键作用。如果大国能够保持我们所谓的战略稳定，这对世界和平与发展非常重要。”
俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、中国领导人习近平和美国国家元首唐纳德·特朗普定于 11 月 19 日在中国深圳举行的 APEC 峰会期间举行三边会议。克里姆林宫助手尤里·乌沙科夫表示，这将是三位领导人首次以这种形式会面。

Russia-China-US summit significant for whole world — senior CPC official
Vice minister of the International Department of the Chinese Communist Party Central Committee Ma Hui opined that if the great powers can maintain strategic stability, that is important for peace and development worldwide
MOSCOW, November 18. /TASS/. The Russia-China-US summit is a significant event for the whole world as the three countries have a key role to play, Ma Hui, vice minister of the International Department of the Chinese Communist Party (CPC) Central Committee, told TASS.
"The very fact that this is happening is a significant event. Great powers, major countries, must bear a special responsibility for peace. We must play a key role in world affairs. If the great powers can maintain what we call strategic stability, that is important for peace and development worldwide," he said.
Russian President Vladimir Putin, Chinese leader Xi Jinping and US head of state Donald Trump are scheduled to hold a trilateral meeting on November 19 on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China. Kremlin aide Yury Ushakov said this would be the three leaders’ first meeting in this format.
